name: Karla
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends imagemagick ghostscript && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
postCreateCommand: sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.claude && npm install --global @anthropic-ai/claude-code && composer install && npm ci && printf 'xdebug.mode=debug,coverage\nxdebug.start_with_request=trigger\n' | sudo tee -a /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/xdebug.ini
